# Kling 3.0 API

> Generate videos with Standard, Pro, 4K and Turbo workflow variants.

Generate videos with Standard, Pro, 4K and Turbo workflow variants.

## Workflows

| Workflow | Endpoint |
| - | - |
| [4K · Text to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-3/4k-text-to-video.md) | `POST /kling-video/v3.0/4k/text-to-video` |
| [Pro · Text to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-3/pro-text-to-video.md) | `POST /kling-video/v3.0/pro/text-to-video` |
| [Standard · Text to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-3/standard-text-to-video.md) | `POST /kling-video/v3.0/std/text-to-video` |
| [Turbo · Text to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-3/turbo-text-to-video.md) | `POST /kling-video/v3.0-turbo/text-to-video` |
| [4K · Image to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-3/4k-image-to-video.md) | `POST /kling-video/v3.0/4k/image-to-video` |
| [Pro · Image to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-3/pro-image-to-video.md) | `POST /kling-video/v3.0/pro/image-to-video` |
| [Standard · Image to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-3/standard-image-to-video.md) | `POST /kling-video/v3.0/std/image-to-video` |
| [Turbo · Image to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-3/turbo-image-to-video.md) | `POST /kling-video/v3.0-turbo/image-to-video` |

Open a workflow to see its complete input schema, required fields, supported values and request examples.
